SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

5. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

8. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
